summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations.
takeaways: This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes.
These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.
Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations.
